passages.text: After being instructed in such things by Peter over a few days and being healed, they were baptized. Then, all deeply grieved by his further wonders, they sat together as a whole populace in the middle of the marketplaces on ashes and sackcloth, repenting over the sins they had previously committed. When those in Sidon heard these things, they did the same and sent suppliants to Peter, since they themselves were unable to come to him because of their diseases. Peter, after staying in Tyre for not many days, instructing everyone in it, freeing them from every kind of affliction, forming a church, and appointing for them a bishop from among the elders who followed him, set out for Sidon. On learning that Peter was coming, Simon immediately fled to Beirut with Appion and his companions.

lexical_decisions.source_quote: τοιαῦτα ὑπὸ τοῦ Πέτρου ἐν ὀλίγαις ἡμέραις κατηχηθέντες
lexical_decisions.chosen: After being instructed in such things by Peter over a few days
lexical_decisions.rationale: κατηχέω here means to instruct orally; “catechized” would preserve the later technical term but would be less accessible in modern English.

lexical_decisions.chosen: deeply grieved by his further wonders
lexical_decisions.rationale: περίλυπος takes the dative as the cause or occasion of grief, and λοιπός can mean remaining, other, or further. “Deeply grieved at his other wonders” is a close alternative.

lexical_decisions.source_quote: πανδημεὶ ἐπὶ σποδοῦ καὶ σάκκου ἐκαθέζοντο
lexical_decisions.chosen: they sat together as a whole populace ... on ashes and sackcloth
lexical_decisions.rationale: πανδημεί means collectively or with the whole populace, while ἐπί with the genitive presents ashes and sackcloth as what they sat upon.

lexical_decisions.chosen: repenting over the sins they had previously committed
lexical_decisions.rationale: The participle describes moral-spiritual repentance in response to earlier sins, while ἐπί identifies those sins as its occasion. Repenting of their former sins is an idiomatic alternative. The separate description deeply grieved remains distinct from repentance, and the preceding baptism and healing sequence is not altered to settle a causal or symbolic interpretation. No extra Godward formula or intensifier is supplied.
In the context of appointing a bishop from among elders, ἐκκλησία denotes an organized congregation or church, and συνίστημι denotes forming or establishing it.

lexical_decisions.chosen: On learning that Peter was coming
lexical_decisions.rationale: In the narrative sequence Peter has just set out for Sidon, so the present participle is best understood as his approach. Because ἥκω can also have a perfect-like sense, “had arrived” remains grammatically possible.
